plan.fixture: leagueInput(2): 4 new matches, fixed masterSeed42, 1 battlefield, 20 steps

interpretation: All 12 trials retained, including both warmups and the slower candidate pair 4. Every trial computed all 4 fixture matches without reuse.
Slot identities, result hashes and compressed chunk/checkpoint checksums agree across both sources and every trial.
Complete semantic/privacy validation is reused only inside a producer scope; the later pass still verifies saved bytes.
The short fixture shows 16 to 12 complete validation calls. Wall medians differ by about 1.2%, within the observed variation; no end-to-end speedup or 270/300-second acceptance is established.
Preparation, process startup, GitHub/artifact/R2/Pages are excluded. This is one short battlefield fixture, not the representative five-battlefield or full-league acceptance plan.
Process CPU includes Worker CPU. Inclusive stage time is not added to CPU or wall. Process high-water RSS includes setup.
The candidate SHA names the tested code commit before adding this evidence file. Its runtime changes are not restamped to a later documentation commit.

reproduction.toolchain: Pinned Node 24.19.0 and pnpm 11.27.1; separate frozen installs for both worktrees. No production credentials.
